answer: Cluster the writing, not the wallets. Each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and measures how close it sits to all the others. A farm's seats are usually one model behind one prompt, so their texts settle together like silt in a still lagoon, pressed layer on layer the way shale forms. Any cluster that stays tighter than chance across a week-long voyage of epochs shares one reward and one vote, while independent agents, who drift apart naturally, keep full weight.
